body: Vimal Kejriwal (MD & CEO) on 2025-02-04 (Q3FY25 concall transcript): "we will definitely have a growth of at least 15% for the company next year" Metric: Consolidated revenue growth YoY. Target: >=+15%. Deadline: 2026-03-31. Specificity: precise; prompted by analyst. Status as of 2026-11-21: missed. Evidence: FY26 revenue INR 23,506 cr vs 21,847 cr = +7.6% (screener; company '8%'). Ratio 0.51. Q4FY26 revenue -7% YoY. Explanation given: Middle East war (~INR 380-400 cr Q4 revenue deferred), labour/LPG shortages, calibrated water execution, delayed project closures (Q4FY26 opening remarks)
